The *Sekkhattika* is an Abhidhamma text situated within the *Paṭṭhāna* collection of the Pali Tipiṭaka [SuttaCentral]. Designated in modern digital cataloging as Patthana 1.12, the text forms the twelfth triad (*tika*) of the collection, dealing with the analytical category of the trainee or learner (*sekkha*) [SuttaCentral]. In the SuttaCentral catalog, it is classified as a leaf text and records one translation into a modern language [SuttaCentral]. No direct discussions of this text were identified in the consulted reference literature.
